# CDT 1.4.4

Unmodified header-only constrained Delaunay triangulation library by Artem Ogre and contributors.

- Source: https://github.com/artem-ogre/CDT/tree/1.4.4/CDT/include
- Archive: https://codeload.github.com/artem-ogre/CDT/zip/refs/tags/1.4.4
- Archive SHA256: `a4bce416f9e08d505f6a6f2672ccace3d4d4993e38e9b0739f6b91e130d2b270`
- License: MPL-2.0; original `LICENSE` and per-file notices are retained. `predicates.h` retains its original robust-predicate notices.

Only the eleven `CDT/include` files are included. No library code is modified. The build manifest hashes this directory recursively. Upgrade deliberately and rerun coastline topology regressions.
